FLOverviewFaultPlatz.description: A placing a slot waits on that its group cannot hand it: the group holds too few clubs, or no rule breaks a tie.
FLOverviewFaultPlatz.title: FLOverviewFaultPlatz

FLOverviewFaultWiring.description: Wiring of the bracket the season cannot hold, whatever its shape.
FLOverviewFaultWiring.title: FLOverviewFaultWiring

FLOverviewParty.description:
One party's open confirmation row, a club's or the booked referee's: the row „Zusage eintragen“ records its agreement on.

`name` is the one its own record holds, as each act's recipients are named, so the page names every party one way.
FLOverviewParty.title: FLOverviewParty

FLOverviewSpielRow.description: A fixture lacking what its kind names, or played and still without a result; its act is the match editor's.
FLOverviewSpielRow.title: FLOverviewSpielRow

FLOverviewSpielberichtRow.description: A report awaiting the administrator: not adopted, changed since its adoption, or written for other clubs.
FLOverviewSpielberichtRow.title: FLOverviewSpielberichtRow

FLOverviewSpielbestaetigungRow.description: A fixture whose parties owe their answer: overdue where one party's answer has lapsed, else still due.
FLOverviewSpielbestaetigungRow.title: FLOverviewSpielbestaetigungRow

FLOverviewVorschlagRow.description:
A club's decline proposing another date and hour, neither adopted nor discarded; its row is the one both acts write.

Each act's recipients are the parties the backend mails of it, each by the name its own record holds, so its question
names them: `adoption_recipients` those the confirmation pass tells of the move, `discard_recipients` the club the
discard tells the date stands.
FLOverviewVorschlagRow.title: FLOverviewVorschlagRow

FLOwnSaisonsResponse.description:
The seasons a signed-in person holds a row in, the newest first, which their own frame's season button offers.

A season the public frame withholds, a planned one, is served as any other: the person's row in it is what the
frame leads to.
FLOwnSaisonsResponse.title: FLOwnSaisonsResponse

FLPatchKaderRowPayload.description: A seat holder's edit of a squad row.
FLPatchKaderRowPayload.title: FLPatchKaderRowPayload

FLPatchSpielDataResponse.description:
The numbers of every fixture the save moved beyond its own edit, the results it destroyed, and the fixture's `version` after it.

`advanced_to` numbers the fixtures the bracket resolution rewrote and `released_sides` those that gave up a side for
this Spieltag. `voided_ergebnisse` is the set a save names in its body to delete those results, and `recipients`, on a
`dry_run` alone, every party the confirmation pass would mail of the change.
FLPatchSpielDataResponse.title: FLPatchSpielDataResponse

FLPatchSpielerSaisonPayload.description:
The Spieler editor's one save: the person, and their squad row in the season the page stands under.

Replaced wholesale, with no consent and no address, each being the person's own to change.
FLPatchSpielerSaisonPayload.title: FLPatchSpielerSaisonPayload

FLPatchTeamSaisonPayload.description:
The team editor's one save: the club, and its colour and group in the season the page stands under.

Replaced wholesale, with no seat and no `austritt`: a seat is its own write's, and an exit is a write of its own,
which owes mail.
FLPatchTeamSaisonPayload.title: FLPatchTeamSaisonPayload

FLPostBewerbungPayload.description:
One school's application, as the public form submits it.

`status`, `submitted_at` and `decision` are the server's.
FLPostBewerbungPayload.title: FLPostBewerbungPayload

FLPostRegistrierungPayload.description:
One pupil registering through a team's link.

The team, the season, the state, the deadline and the confirmation link come from the invite and the clock, never from this body.
FLPostRegistrierungPayload.title: FLPostRegistrierungPayload

FLPostSchiedsrichterResponse.description: The created referee and the link the create owed them, which every create owes.
FLPostSchiedsrichterResponse.title: FLPostSchiedsrichterResponse

FLPostTeamEntryPayload.description: One club's entry into a season, the club known or new. One field rather than two nullable ones, so no body names both.
FLPostTeamEntryPayload.title: FLPostTeamEntryPayload

FLReferencesPayload.description: The sign-in addresses a pass of the account sweep asks about.
FLReferencesPayload.title: FLReferencesPayload

FLReferencesResponse.description: Which of them nothing references, and nothing of the records that reference the others.
FLReferencesResponse.title: FLReferencesResponse

FLRegistrierungAbsageData.description: A team's decline, to a pupil whose address was confirmed.
FLRegistrierungAbsageData.title: FLRegistrierungAbsageData

FLRegistrierungAdmitPayload.description: The team's answer to the question the read asked: the person this registration is admitted into, or none.
FLRegistrierungAdmitPayload.title: FLRegistrierungAdmitPayload

FLRegistrierungConfirmationPayload.description: One pupil's own answer: their date of birth and the two consents.
FLRegistrierungConfirmationPayload.title: FLRegistrierungConfirmationPayload

FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewConfirmed.description: A link opened again after the pupil's own answer.
FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewConfirmed.title: FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewConfirmed

FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewExpired.description: A lapsed link, or one whose club left the season, which opens nothing more.
FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewExpired.title: FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewExpired

FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewValid.description: A standing link: what the pupil registered for, until when, and the age bounds their answer is judged by.
FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewValid.title: FLRegistrierungConfirmationViewValid

FLRegistrierungDeclinePayload.description: Why the team declines, from a closed set or not at all.
FLRegistrierungDeclinePayload.title: FLRegistrierungDeclinePayload

FLRegistrierungLinkData.description: A pupil's confirmation link, owed by the submission or a corrected address.
FLRegistrierungLinkData.title: FLRegistrierungLinkData

FLRegistrierungPerson.description: The stored person a confirmed registration's address resolves to, named so the team can be asked whether it is the same one.
FLRegistrierungPerson.title: FLRegistrierungPerson

FLRegistrierungSweepResponse.description: One season's pass: the rows it passed over, which the next pass meets again.
FLRegistrierungSweepResponse.title: FLRegistrierungSweepResponse

FLReplaceSaisonTeamPayload.description: Which club takes this season's row over. The path names the club going out.
FLReplaceSaisonTeamPayload.title: FLReplaceSaisonTeamPayload

FLSaisonActRefusals.description:
Why each of the editor's season acts would be refused if pressed now, judged by its write's own rules; null where it takes it.

`activate` and `undraw` are their writes' whole judgement, and `create` and `recreate` the draw's judgement of the
stored rules over the clubs entered, `recreate` then the reports it would delete.
FLSaisonActRefusals.title: FLSaisonActRefusals

FLSaisonAdmin.description: The season as its editor reads it, with whether it has started, whether a fixture of it has taken place and whether it is decided.
FLSaisonAdmin.title: FLSaisonAdmin

FLSaisonAdminIncomingTeam.description: A club a replacement may bring into the season: one still in the league that holds no row of it.
FLSaisonAdminIncomingTeam.title: FLSaisonAdminIncomingTeam

FLSaisonAdminListed.description: One season as the admin list shows it: whether it has started and is decided, and how many clubs and matches it holds.
FLSaisonAdminListed.title: FLSaisonAdminListed

FLSaisonAdminResponse.description:
What the season editor shows, in one read: its season, clubs, shapes and matchdays, its acts' states and its registration links.

`shapes` is every shape the season's other rules admit, which its rules form offers;
`spielplan` is the Spielplan the season holds, `null` while it holds no fixture; `invitations`
holds one row per club, in `teams`' order.
FLSaisonAdminResponse.title: FLSaisonAdminResponse

FLSaisonAdminTeam.description: One club's row of the season as the swap and the replacement list it, and as its registration link's row names it.
FLSaisonAdminTeam.title: FLSaisonAdminTeam

FLSaisonBewerbung.description:
When the league accepts applications for this season: while today lies between `start` and `end`, both included.

`open` pauses the form alone, its dates untouched and the applications already received staying in triage.
FLSaisonBewerbung.title: FLSaisonBewerbung

FLSaisonBewerbungPayload.description: The application window as a season write sends it, judged apart from the season's own span: it may open before the season does.
FLSaisonBewerbungPayload.title: FLSaisonBewerbungPayload

FLSaisonDrawn.description: A season's Spielplan as every write judges it: the matchdays and fixtures it holds, counted per read, and the draw's day.
FLSaisonDrawn.title: FLSaisonDrawn

FLSaisonForfeitErgebnis.description:
What a fixture is awarded when one side does not appear, as both sides' goals rather than a margin.

A level award needs a season with no knockout round.
FLSaisonForfeitErgebnis.title: FLSaisonForfeitErgebnis

FLSaisonFrameEntry.description: One season as a frame's season button lists it: its id and its span.
FLSaisonFrameEntry.title: FLSaisonFrameEntry

FLSaisonFrameResponse.description:
Every season the public may read, the newest first, and the one the site is on.

`active_saison_id` is null for a league no season has been activated in; a season stays active, finished or not,
until the next is activated.
FLSaisonFrameResponse.title: FLSaisonFrameResponse

FLSaisonRegistrierung.description:
When a pupil's entry is an ordinary one: from the season's activation to `end`, which falls before the season's start.

Past `end` the link runs on until the season ends and an entry is a Nachnominierung; `open` pauses the link alone.
FLSaisonRegistrierung.title: FLSaisonRegistrierung

FLSaisonRetentionResponse.description: One season's pass over its season rows, fixture answers and match reports: the rows it passed over, which the next pass meets again.
FLSaisonRetentionResponse.title: FLSaisonRetentionResponse

FLSaisonTeamConfirmationView.description: One seat's link as the contacts editor reads it: the stored link and whether it has lapsed.
FLSaisonTeamConfirmationView.title: FLSaisonTeamConfirmationView

FLSaisonTeamEntry.description: One club of a season as the Teams page lists it: the name and shorthand it plays this season under.
FLSaisonTeamEntry.title: FLSaisonTeamEntry

FLSaisonTeamKontakteAdmin.description: The three seats as the team editor reads them, nullable per seat as stored.
FLSaisonTeamKontakteAdmin.title: FLSaisonTeamKontakteAdmin

FLSaisonsAdminListResponse.description: Every season, with the id the next create mints and why a create would be refused now.
FLSaisonsAdminListResponse.title: FLSaisonsAdminListResponse

FLSaisonsAdminRefusals.description: Why the list's act would be refused if pressed now, by its write's own judgement; null where it takes it.
FLSaisonsAdminRefusals.title: FLSaisonsAdminRefusals

FLSchiedsrichterAccountEinwilligungPaylo.description: A referee's own two choices on their record.
FLSchiedsrichterAccountEinwilligungPaylo.title: FLSchiedsrichterAccountEinwilligungPayload

FLSchiedsrichterAdmin.description:
One referee as their editor reads them: the list's row, the fields the save writes, and the link's days.

No birthdate: it is asked once for the age check, and no page of the administration shows it.
FLSchiedsrichterAdmin.title: FLSchiedsrichterAdmin

FLSchiedsrichterAdminRow.description: One referee as the administration's list shows them: the name, where the entry stands, and how to reach them.
FLSchiedsrichterAdminRow.title: FLSchiedsrichterAdminRow

FLSchiedsrichterAnswer.description: What a referee answered through their link, as the administration reads it: the day and the two choices, never the evidence.
FLSchiedsrichterAnswer.title: FLSchiedsrichterAnswer

FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationData.description: A referee's confirmation link, owed by their entry, a corrected address, a re-send or their return.
FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationData.title: FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationData

FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewConfirme.description: A link opened again after its consent.
FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewConfirme.title: FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewConfirmed

FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewExpired.description: A lapsed link, which opens nothing more.
FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewExpired.title: FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewExpired

FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewValid.description: A standing link: the question's day and the age bounds its answer is judged by.
FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewValid.title: FLSchiedsrichterConfirmationViewValid

FLSchiedsrichterKontakt.description: A referee's channel as the administration reads it.
FLSchiedsrichterKontakt.title: FLSchiedsrichterKontakt

FLSchiedsrichterMint.description: The confirmation link a write owed the referee, which the Postausgang mints and mails: never the link itself.
FLSchiedsrichterMint.title: FLSchiedsrichterMint

FLSchiedsrichterSpiel.description:
One fixture booked to the signed-in referee, as their one list shows it.

The fixture as the public reads serve it, with its matchday, as a club's own list serves its matches; and the booking
they were asked about and the report they owe.
FLSchiedsrichterSpiel.title: FLSchiedsrichterSpiel

FLSchiedsrichterSpieleResponse.description: A referee's fixtures of one season, in the order the draw numbered them.
FLSchiedsrichterSpieleResponse.title: FLSchiedsrichterSpieleResponse

FLSchiedsrichterSweepResponse.description: One pass of the unconfirmed entries' clock: the entries it erased and the ones it passed over, which stay due.
FLSchiedsrichterSweepResponse.title: FLSchiedsrichterSweepResponse

FLSchiedsrichterTextVersions.description: A referee's two wordings: the name on the fixtures and the media switch.
FLSchiedsrichterTextVersions.title: FLSchiedsrichterTextVersions

FLSeatEinwilligungPayload.description:
A seat holder's own two choices for every seat they hold on one row.

Both choices on every press: a page that sent one alone would leave the other judged by nothing.
FLSeatEinwilligungPayload.title: FLSeatEinwilligungPayload

FLSeatTextVersions.description: A contact seat's two wordings: the WhatsApp switch and the media switch.
FLSeatTextVersions.title: FLSeatTextVersions

FLSignInResponse.description:
The sign-in gate's whole answer: the records' two flags, the ban and the grant, and no record itself.

The ban narrows neither flag: whether a barred person signs in is the gate's to decide.
FLSignInResponse.title: FLSignInResponse

FLSpielEditorAufstellungMarks.description:
Each side's line-up marks, off the clock alone, as the club's own pages are served them.

Null for an open side and for a fixture with no day or hour. A fixture carrying an event owes no line-up either,
which a page reads off its `sonderereignis`, as the club's own pages do.
FLSpielEditorAufstellungMarks.title: FLSpielEditorAufstellungMarks

FLSpielEditorAufstellungen.description: Each side's line-up as the editor's line states it, the club the fixture fields there now; null where it has stored none.
FLSpielEditorAufstellungen.title: FLSpielEditorAufstellungen

FLSpielEditorBericht.description:
The fixture's report as the editor's Spielbericht section shows it: its goals and the result they propose.

`version` is the report document's, the one an adoption names (`adopts_bericht`), and `named` each pupil a goal
names, by the names their record holds.
FLSpielEditorBericht.title: FLSpielEditorBericht

FLSpielEditorSchiedsrichter.description: A referee the editor offers: their whole name, the fee they default to, whether they confirmed their entry, and the day they retired.
FLSpielEditorSchiedsrichter.title: FLSpielEditorSchiedsrichter

FLSpielEditorSpieler.description: A pupil a goal names, by the names their record holds, both null where no record holds the pupil.
FLSpielEditorSpieler.title: FLSpielEditorSpieler

FLSpielEditorSpielort.description: A venue the editor offers: its name, the rent it defaults to, and the day it retired, null while it serves.
FLSpielEditorSpielort.title: FLSpielEditorSpielort

FLSpielEditorTeam.description:
A club a knockout fixture's Begegnung offers for either side, by the name and shorthand its season row holds.

`on_spieltag` says the club stands on another fixture of this matchday, and `fieldable` whether a save fielding it
here as the fixture stands would pass.
FLSpielEditorTeam.title: FLSpielEditorTeam

FLSpielEinteilungData.description: A referee's word that they are booked onto a fixture, which they answer on their own panel.
FLSpielEinteilungData.title: FLSpielEinteilungData

FLSpielEinteilungLiftedData.description: A referee's word that they were taken off a fixture after being told of it: the slot they were told of.
FLSpielEinteilungLiftedData.title: FLSpielEinteilungLiftedData

FLSpielElfmeterschiessen.description: The penalty shoot-out that settled a level knockout fixture: the side with more goals in it won.
FLSpielElfmeterschiessen.title: FLSpielElfmeterschiessen

FLSpielElfmeterschiessenPayload.description: A shoot-out as a save sends it: a key beside the two counts is refused, never dropped.
FLSpielElfmeterschiessenPayload.title: FLSpielElfmeterschiessenPayload

FLSpielJoined.description:
One fixture as the public reads serve it, each side with its club's standing in the season.

The referee is served only once they accepted the fixture as it stands, or where the booking names nobody.
FLSpielJoined.title: FLSpielJoined

FLSpielJoinedAdmin.description:
The same fixture for the admin reads: the referee as booked, whole name and payment, and the venue's rent.

`version` counts the fixture's writes; a save sending it back is refused once another write has raised it.
FLSpielJoinedAdmin.title: FLSpielJoinedAdmin

FLSpielMailAnsetzung.description: A fixture as a mail asking about it states it, its ground among the rest.
FLSpielMailAnsetzung.title: FLSpielMailAnsetzung

FLSpielMailAppointment.description: A fixture's slot as a mail names it: its two sides in the fixture's order, its day and its hour.
FLSpielMailAppointment.title: FLSpielMailAppointment

FLSpielMailEntry.description: A fixture as a mail lists it: its two sides in the fixture's order, its day and its hour where it holds them.
FLSpielMailEntry.title: FLSpielMailEntry

FLSpielMovedData.description:
A party's word that a fixture it was asked about left that slot, owed where no request about its new slot goes now.

The mail's own request carries the move where the new slot is asked at once (`FLSpielRequestData.moved_from`).
FLSpielMovedData.title: FLSpielMovedData

FLSpielNoticeData.description: A party's word that a fixture it was asked about will not be played: the slot it was asked about, and the event.
FLSpielNoticeData.title: FLSpielNoticeData

FLSpielPageResponse.description:
One match as its page and its pop-up show it.

The match, its matchday's `position` and its phase's count of matchdays, which together name the matchday, where
each side stands, each side's line-up from the moment its club stores one, and what the public may read of its
report, null where none is stored.
FLSpielPageResponse.title: FLSpielPageResponse

FLSpielQuelleGruppe.description: A slot fed by the group phase: the team finishing `platz` in `gruppe`.
FLSpielQuelleGruppe.title: FLSpielQuelleGruppe

FLSpielQuelleSpiel.description: A slot fed by an earlier fixture: the side that came out of match `spiel_nr` as `ausgang`.
FLSpielQuelleSpiel.title: FLSpielQuelleSpiel

FLSpielRequestData.description: A club's request to confirm a fixture, or the reminder of it, each leading to the club's own pages.
FLSpielRequestData.title: FLSpielRequestData

FLSpielSchiedsrichterField.description: The referee as the admin reads serve them: the whole name and the payment.
FLSpielSchiedsrichterField.title: FLSpielSchiedsrichterField

FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPayload.description: The referee as the save sends it: who, and what this fixture pays them.
FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPayload.title: FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPayload

FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPublic.description:
The referee as the public reads serve it: a forename and a surname initial where they consented, else no name.

Neither the payment, the referee's id nor the consent deciding the name is served: the name is the answer.
FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPublic.title: FLSpielSchiedsrichterFieldPublic

FLSpielSideStanding.description: Where one side of a group match stands in the Tabelle: its group, and its `platz`, null while it holds none.
FLSpielSideStanding.title: FLSpielSideStanding

FLSpielSideStandings.description:
Each side's place in the Tabelle on a group match.

Null on a knockout match, whose round is the match's own phase, and for a side the groups do not list.
FLSpielSideStandings.title: FLSpielSideStandings

FLSpielTeamFieldJoined.description: One side as a read serves it: its club's name and shorthand in the season, and the way it left, null while it has not.
FLSpielTeamFieldJoined.title: FLSpielTeamFieldJoined

FLSpielTeamFieldPayload.description:
One side of a fixture as the save sends it: the team and its goals.

A name sent is ignored: a side's name and shorthand are its season row's, joined at read.
FLSpielTeamFieldPayload.title: FLSpielTeamFieldPayload

FLSpielVoidedErgebnis.description: A later fixture's stored result that a save deletes: its ground score, its shoot-out and a no-show, each null where it held none.
FLSpielVoidedErgebnis.title: FLSpielVoidedErgebnis

FLSpielVorschlagDiscardedData.description: A club's word that the league kept the date it declined and proposed another for: the slot that stands.
FLSpielVorschlagDiscardedData.title: FLSpielVorschlagDiscardedData

FLSpielberichtBericht.description: The referee's account of one match and its one proposal; the referee's every correction clears its adoption.
FLSpielberichtBericht.title: FLSpielberichtBericht

FLSpielberichtCard.description:
One card: who was shown it, when, and its colour.

A null `spieler_id` names nobody, as a scorer's does: a side whose club holds no squad still takes cards.
FLSpielberichtCard.title: FLSpielberichtCard

FLSpielberichtCardPayload.description: One card as the referee's save sends it: a key the card does not declare is refused, never dropped.
FLSpielberichtCardPayload.title: FLSpielberichtCardPayload

FLSpielberichtKader.description: Each side's live squad of the season, the pupils a new entry may name.
FLSpielberichtKader.title: FLSpielberichtKader

FLSpielberichtPayload.description: The whole `bericht` block, written wholesale by the referee's PUT.
FLSpielberichtPayload.title: FLSpielberichtPayload

FLSpielberichtPublic.description:
What the public may read of one match's report.

The scorers and the cards only while the referee's report reads `adopted` -- adopted, unchanged since, and
matching the result -- each by minute; null otherwise, which is "not official yet" where an empty list is "nobody
scored".
FLSpielberichtPublic.title: FLSpielberichtPublic

FLSpielberichtSchiedsrichterResponse.description: The booked referee's form, the stored remarks included.
FLSpielberichtSchiedsrichterResponse.title: FLSpielberichtSchiedsrichterResponse

FLSpielberichtScorer.description: One goal. A null `spieler_id` names nobody: a scorer the referee did not name, or a pupil erased since, read alike.
FLSpielberichtScorer.title: FLSpielberichtScorer

FLSpielberichtScorerPayload.description: One goal as the referee's save sends it: a key the goal does not declare is refused, never dropped.
FLSpielberichtScorerPayload.title: FLSpielberichtScorerPayload

FLSpielberichtScorerPublic.description: One goal: `side` is the scorer's own club, and an own goal (`eigentor`) counts for the other one.
FLSpielberichtScorerPublic.title: FLSpielberichtScorerPublic

FLSpielberichtSides.description:
The clubs the fixture fielded at the block's last write, null on a slot then open.

Stamped by every write and on no payload: entries go by side, and a knockout correction can re-field one.
FLSpielberichtSides.title: FLSpielberichtSides

FLSpielberichtSpiel.description: The fixture a report is about, as its form states it: no money, no booking, no result.
FLSpielberichtSpiel.title: FLSpielberichtSpiel

FLSpielberichtSpieler.description: A pupil a report may name or names, with the names their record holds, both null where no record holds the pupil.
FLSpielberichtSpieler.title: FLSpielberichtSpieler

FLSpielberichtSpielerPublic.description:
One pupil an entry names, as the base tier serves them, without their record's id.

The names where the pupil's consent publishes them, the surname as an initial; both null where it does not, and
where the entry names nobody, which the two cases share.
FLSpielberichtSpielerPublic.title: FLSpielberichtSpielerPublic

FLSpielberichtVorschlag.description:
The referee's proposed result, which only the administrator's own save applies.

Each count is the entries credited to that side, written by the report's save and sent by no form, and both are null
on a no-show alone, whose goals the save composes from the season's forfeit.
FLSpielberichtVorschlag.title: FLSpielberichtVorschlag

FLSpielberichtVorschlagPayload.description: What the referee proposes beside the goals: a shoot-out, or the event the match ended in.
FLSpielberichtVorschlagPayload.title: FLSpielberichtVorschlagPayload

FLSpielbestaetigungAnswer.description: Written once, while the row is open: a second press finds the row answered and changes nothing.
FLSpielbestaetigungAnswer.title: FLSpielbestaetigungAnswer

FLSpielbestaetigungAppointment.description: A date and time without a ground: a team's proposal, and the slot a row asked about, one a moved fixture left among them.
FLSpielbestaetigungAppointment.title: FLSpielbestaetigungAppointment

FLSpielbestaetigungByKontakt.description: The seat its holder answered from, never the person: of two seats one person holds, the first in order is recorded.
FLSpielbestaetigungByKontakt.title: FLSpielbestaetigungByKontakt

FLSpielbestaetigungEditorRow.description:
A confirmation row as the match editor reads it, the state it stands in, a closed row's included, and the league's acts it takes.

Never `vorschlag`, which only a club's own page tells: an open row reads `valid` while its party may still answer.
FLSpielbestaetigungEditorRow.title: FLSpielbestaetigungEditorRow

FLSpielbestaetigungEditorVorschlag.description:
A club's decline proposing another date and hour, neither adopted nor discarded, and whom each act on it mails.

Each recipient by the name its own record holds, as the Übersicht names them: `adoption_recipients` those the
confirmation pass tells of the move, `discard_recipients` the club the discard tells the date stands.
FLSpielbestaetigungEditorVorschlag.title: FLSpielbestaetigungEditorVorschlag

FLSpielbestaetigungEnterPayload.description:
The administrator's Zusage for a party that answered elsewhere, and how it was given.

No way to choose: the one press records a Zusage, and a decline without a proposal would sit in no queue.
FLSpielbestaetigungEnterPayload.title: FLSpielbestaetigungEnterPayload

FLSpielbestaetigungSchiedsrichterAnswerP.description: A referee's answer about one row naming them: a decline gives a reason, which the administrator reads.
FLSpielbestaetigungSchiedsrichterAnswerP.title: FLSpielbestaetigungSchiedsrichterAnswerPayload

FLSpielbestaetigungSweepResponse.description: One season's pass, counted: what it closed, the rows it asked or reminded, and the mails it owed the Postausgang.
FLSpielbestaetigungSweepResponse.title: FLSpielbestaetigungSweepResponse

FLSpielbestaetigungTeamAnswerPayload.description: One club's answer about one Ansetzung, from whichever of its seats presses first.
FLSpielbestaetigungTeamAnswerPayload.title: FLSpielbestaetigungTeamAnswerPayload

FLSpielbestaetigungViewAnsetzung.description: The clubs, the day, the hour and the ground a page or a message states, the fixture's as it stands.
